planets.name: Kepler-1542 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1542 with a 5.99-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-1542 d crosses its star every 5.99 days and is 0.87 times as wide as Earth, found in 2016.
text.introduction: Kepler-1542 d transits Kepler-1542 every 5.99 days and is 0.87 times as wide as Earth. Orbit and size follow Morton et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
